newsitem.title: USA: Uromed sees '97 revs at current levels.
newsitem.headline: Uromed sees '97 revs at current levels.

text.p: UroMed Corp said Thursday that revenues were likely to remain at current levels throughout the rest of 1997.
The company reported revenues of $152,000 in the second quarter of 1997, compared with revenues of $661,000 in the prior year period.

In a statement, chairman and chief executive John Simon said, "As we had expected, given the slow up-take of Reliance, our U.S. product sales levels rose slightly this quarter from the preceding quarter, while total sales declined this quarter due to lower recognition of deferred international revenue."
The company, a healthcare products provider, focuses on the provision of continence care systems. The Reliance Urinary Controller Insert is one of its products.
